classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing payment methods in the customer account section, including listing, deleting, and retrieving available payment methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the payment method page, ensuring user is logged in and loading the necessary view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of available payment methods, handling permissions and session validation.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves and constructs the list of enabled payment methods.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified payment method, handling session and customer authentication, and returns a JSON response.
